summary: Autodesk filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a September 8 underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley, BNP Paribas, and Citigroup as representatives for a $1.0 billion public debt offering: $500 million of 5.050% notes due 2029 and $500 million of 5.650% notes due 2033, issued under a Form S-3 shelf and a seventh supplemental indenture. Interest pays semi-annually from March 15, 2027. Proceeds plus cash on hand repay a $1.0 billion June 15, 2026 term loan. This is a routine investment-grade refinancing, not a special situation; watch for change-of-control repurchase triggers only.
